Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a classic AP-MS (Affinity Purification Mass Spectrometry) using FLAG-tagged RhoA. Quantification was performed using spectral counting (label-free). While the Orbitrap Fusion is capable of DIA, the use of MaxQuant default settings and spectral counting for PPI scoring strongly indicates a DDA workflow.

scope: Affinity purification and downstream mass spectrometry analysis was performed as previously described.

For FLAG purification, 30 μmL of bead slurry (Anti-Flag M2 Magnetic Beads, Sigma) was washed twice with 1 mL of ice-cold wash buffer (50 mM Tris pH 7.4, 150 mM NaCl, 1 mM EDTA) and the lysate was incubated with the anti-FLAG beads at 4°C with agitation for 2 h on a KingFisher Flex.
Bound proteins were eluted by incubating beads with 30 μmL of 100 μg/ml 3xFLAG peptide in 0.05% RapiGest in wash buffer for 15 min at RT with shaking.
